blind.description: A sturdy wooden workbench or merchant display table loaded with smith-crafted metal goods. The tabletop holds two handled iron cauldrons, a skillet, rectangular iron ingots, horseshoes, a visored helmet, metal bars/rods, and a small lantern with warm amber glowing panels. The table has heavy wooden legs with connecting stretchers, resting flat on the ground. Geometry is solid, clean, and stylized with hand-painted metal and wood textures.
blind.from_above: A rectangular brown wooden surface densely packed with dark circular cooking pots, a frying pan with handle, ingots, horseshoes, a segmented helmet, metal bars, and a square-topped lantern.
blind.height_vs_figure: The table surface is about knee-to-thigh height, reaching roughly half the figure's height to the top of the cauldrons (around 2.5 to 3 feet tall), and about 5 to 6 feet long.
